title: rec-c1-8-authoritative-evidence-handoff
summary: REC-C1.8 closes the three acceptance discrepancies left open after REC-C1.7: (a) documental truth drift (active_gate, control-plane tag peel reference 9ee74f09 -> 6190390d), (b) the three dual_truth RED tests still on main under a file-level allow, (c) UAT-REC-C1-01 (used 64 records + >=10 floor instead of literal 10k), UAT-REC-C1-03 (asserted the negative, not the forced-gap case), UAT-REC-C1-05 (no wall-clock dimension exists on ExecutionRecord). No new architecture, no legacy deletion; REC-C2 owns EventBus / drain_raw_events / fired_buffer / TripwireFired retirement.
blockers: C1.8.5 option — confirm wall-clock dimension: A (add captured_at_unix_ns: Option<u64> to ExecutionRecord, 4-dim independence UAT, default) vs B (amend MILESTONE_ACCEPTANCE.md UAT-REC-C1-05 wording + ADR 0006, defer wall-clock to REC-C4/CONN-001).

C1.8.4 — UAT-REC-C1-03 forced-gap positive test is `#[ignore]`-marked and BLOCKED on a `chronos_log::segmented` bookkeeping bug: any path that inserts a `Gap` entry into a `SegmentedExecutionLog` (both the `record_gap` direct API and the memory-budget overflow path) produces a segment header that mis-counts ('segment declares N records but holds N-1' on reopen). The negative test (`complete` for clean session) passes; the positive test (`gap_detected` for forced-gap) is gated on the fix, which is out of scope for REC-C1 and belongs in a separate m1-* follow-up cycle. See `chronos-sandbox/tests/rec_c1_8_uat_c1_03_forced_gap.rs` file-level doc-comment.

no_action: FIND-C1.8-01 (real bug, real reproducer, deferred): `chronos_log::segmented` segment-header bookkeeping mis-counts gap entries. Any path that writes a `Gap` entry into a `SegmentedExecutionLog` (the `record_gap` direct API, or the memory-budget overflow path) produces a segment header that declares N records but the on-disk file holds N-1, so the segment is rejected on reopen with a 'replay integrity failure'. Reproducer in `chronos-sandbox/tests/rec_c1_8_uat_c1_03_forced_gap.rs::uat_rec_c1_03_forced_gap_reports_gap_detected` (currently `#[ignore]`-marked). Belongs in an `m1-*` follow-up cycle; out of scope for REC-C1.
